runtimeInvariants: Needs you has id and label needsYou, and is the first section.
Section ids, row keys, column keys and source ids are unique within their containers.
Every row has exactly the declared columns and references only named sources.
A source without observedAt has unknown freshness, never a claimed age.
All sections declare key order, compared by code unit; collectors sort before rendering.
Source strings are scrubbed at snapshot creation and again over canonical output bytes before hashing.
Then compute contentHash as SHA-256 of the scrubbed canonical JSON excluding /header/asOf and /header/contentHash; verify the same bytes when reading saved reports.
Only /header/contentHash is excluded from output scrubbing by schema path, never by value, key name alone or a general hexadecimal exemption; JSON, display and diff hash metadata preserve it.
Schema validation alone certifies neither output scrubbing nor content-hash verification.
